info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Investment Portfolio Deposits-v4-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Deposit Listing API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of deposits associated with investment portfolios. This endpoint is designed for financial analysts and portfolio managers who need to monitor and assess the deposit activities within their investment accounts. By utilizing this API, users can gain insights into the volume and frequency of deposits, enabling them to make informed decisions. The API supports various query parameters for filtering and sorting the results, ensuring flexibility in data retrieval.

get.summary: Retrieve deposit details from the portfolio.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch information regarding deposits made to their portfolio. The response will include details such as deposit amounts, dates, and transaction IDs, enabling users to track and manage their investments effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a deposit into a user's portfolio. It should contain the necessary details required for processing the deposit, such as the amount and currency type.

ListInvestmentPortfolioDepositsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the portfolio's deposit endpoint. It is expected to be a string.
